fullPassage: We are always teaching our children something by our words and our actions. They learn from seeing. They learn from hearing and from overhearing. Children share the values of their parents about the most important things in life. Our priorities and principles and our examples of good behavior can teach our children to take the high road when other roads look tempting. Remember that children do not learn the values that make up strong character simply by being told about them. They learn by seeing the people around them act on and uphold those values in their daily lives. Therefore show your child good examples of life by your action. In our daily lives, we can show our children that we respect others. We can show them our compassion and concern when others are suffering, and our own self-discipline, courage and honesty as we make difficult decisions.

Children share the values of their parents about the most important things in life. Our priorities and principles and our examples of good behavior can teach our children to take the high road when other roads look tempting. Remember that children do not learn the values that make up strong character simply by being told about them. They learn by seeing the people around them act on and uphold those values in their daily lives. Therefore show your child good examples of life by your action. In our daily lives, we can show our children that we respect others. We can show them our compassion and concern when others are suffering, and our own self-discipline, courage and honesty as we make difficult decisions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 일치: 'our own self-discipline, courage and honesty as we make difficult decisions'

✅ ② 일치: 'examples of good behavior can teach our children to take the high road when other roads look tempting'

❌ ③ 불일치: 본문은 오히려 'compassion and concern'(연민과 염려) 같은 감정을 보여주라고 했어요. 감정을 드러내지 말라는 것은 정반대 ←정답

✅ ④ 일치: 'Our priorities and principles ~ can teach our children'
det.tip: 본문은 연민·염려 같은 감정을 '보여주라'고 함

ch: 아이들은 부모가 어려운 결정을 내릴 때 보이는 정직과 용기에서도 배운다.
좋은 행동의 본보기는 아이가 유혹 속에서도 바른 선택을 하도록 돕는다.
필자는 부모가 감정을 드러내지 않고 아이를 가르쳐야 한다고 주장한다.
부모의 우선순위와 원칙은 아이를 가르칠 수 있다.

questions.passage: We are always __________ (teach) our children something by our words and our actions. They learn from seeing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis:
정답: teaching

'We are always __________'에서 be동사 are 뒤이고 'always(늘)'와 함께 쓰여 '늘 ~하고 있다'는 현재진행형이 필요해요. 그래서 teach를 teaching으로 바꿔요.

뜻: 우리는 늘 아이들에게 무언가를 '가르치고 있다'.
det.tip: be동사 + 동사ing = 현재진행형. teach → teaching

det.analysis:

❌ ② 학교 교육: 본문에 학교 언급 없음

❌ ③ 규칙과 처벌: 본문은 처벌이 아닌 본보기를 강조
